label: Standard-rated supply
source_note: VAT Act, section 5. Check supply classification and tax point; the approval window ends 31 December 2026.

label: Zero-rated supply
source_note: VAT Act Second Schedule. Zero-rating requires the applicable schedule entry and evidence.

label: Exempt supply
source_note: VAT Act First Schedule. Classification code, not a zero-rated supply. Related input tax is not automatically deductible.

label: Outside VAT scope
source_note: Reviewer must explain why this transaction is outside the charge to VAT. This does not establish income-tax deductibility.

label: Historical petroleum VAT only
source_note: Historical qualifying petroleum transactions only. Not valid from 1 July 2023.

label: Withholding VAT by appointed agent
source_note: Appointed-agent status and taxable supply required. This is a withholding credit, not the supply VAT rate.

label: Monthly PAYE bands and resident personal relief
source_note: Income Tax Act Third Schedule. Cumulative MONTHLY upper limits. Personal relief only where residence eligibility is established.

label: Annual individual bands and resident personal relief
source_note: Annual bands entered separately; do not multiply rounded monthly bands by twelve. Full calendar-year standard resident computation only.

label: Payroll deduction caps and insurance relief
source_note: Registered pension cap includes employee NSSF. Qualifying mortgage and post-retirement medical fund conditions apply. Insurance premiums require eligibility and evidence. No duplicate AHL/SHIF relief.

label: Standard resident corporation tax
source_note: Income Tax Act Third Schedule. Standard resident company only. Special regimes require separate verified rules.

label: Turnover tax on qualifying sales
source_note: Income Tax Act section 12C. Exclude professional, management, training and rental income and other excluded categories. No expense deductions against this tax base.

label: Qualifying resident residential rental income
source_note: Income Tax Act section 6A. Gross residential rent received, eligibility band and election require reviewer confirmation. Commercial rent is not this regime.

label: Capital gains tax on net taxable gain
source_note: Income Tax Act Eighth/Third Schedules. Verify transfer, adjusted cost, exemptions and whether disposal is instead trading income.

label: Professional / management / training fees · resident
source_note: Income Tax Act section 35 and Third Schedule. 2026 review window only. Confirm payment category, aggregate threshold where applicable, exemption, treaty and final/creditable status. Do not infer applicability from supplier name.

label: Professional / management / training fees · non-resident

label: Housing levy · employee
source_note: Affordable Housing Act 2024. Payroll only. Employee and employer sides are separate. Current PAYE deduction treatment comes from the payroll schedule.

label: Housing levy · employer
source_note: Affordable Housing Act 2024. Payroll only. Employee and employer sides are separate. Current PAYE deduction treatment comes from the payroll schedule.

label: Salaried SHIF contribution
source_note: Social Health Insurance Regulations, regulation 17. Minimum applies per employee; no employer match in this schedule.

label: NSSF Year 4 (February 2026 onwards)
source_note: Year 4 official notice. Per employee limits; Tier I 540 each, Tier II up to 5940 each, total maximum 6480 each. Earlier payroll periods need the earlier approved schedule.

label: Employer industrial training levy
source_note: Industrial Training Act / Levy Order. Employer cost, not an employee deduction. Confirm any exemption. Remittance calendar must be separately verified.

label: Fringe benefit market-interest benchmark
source_note: Income Tax Act section 12B / 16(2)(ja), as applicable. This is an annual interest benchmark, NOT the tax percentage. Monthly balance must be supported; variable balances need a reviewed weighted basis.

label: Deemed-interest benchmark
source_note: Income Tax Act section 12B / 16(2)(ja), as applicable. This is an annual interest benchmark, NOT the tax percentage. Monthly balance must be supported; variable balances need a reviewed weighted basis.

label: Withholding on deemed interest
source_note: Apply to calculated deemed interest subject to the statutory conditions, not directly to the loan principal.
